purpose: Fresh IndPenSim campaign for phase-2 model selection and independent evaluation

untouched_test.use_policy: Do not load, summarize, visualize, or score these batches until the selected model and threshold are locked.

randomness: Each batch runs in an independent Octave process. Upstream IndPenSim draws a random seed offset and then combines it with Batch_ref; exact generated CSV hashes are recorded because a clean rerun may differ.
